title: 24th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/24/2/2025).

Question time: Vaikaradhoo MP Hussain Ziyad asks Minister of Islamic Affairs Dr Mohamed Shaheem Ali Saeed how many people were taken on Hajj this year (2025) in the order of the list of those who had paid.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of two members to the Human Rights Commission under Article 190(b) of the Constitution and Article 5 of the Human Rights Commission Act (Law No. 6/2006) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the Zakat Bill submitted on behalf of the government by Vilufushi MP Hassan Waheed.
Report of the Judiciary Committee on the Bill amending the Attorney General's Office Act (Law No. 8/2025).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the Islamic Affairs Minister on Hajj places, sent Human Rights Commission nominees to committee, began debating the Zakat Bill, and took up a committee report on the Attorney General's Office Act amendment.
